none: PAS NLM-948640: Roman Nummus of House of Valentinian from Swinhope
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of the House of Valentinian (364-378), Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust diademed, draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]VALEN [--]AVG. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right dragging captive and holding labarum. Reverse inscription: [GLO]RIA [ROM]ANORVM. In exergue: SCO, probably for Arles mint.
